text: At its meeting of May 22, 2018, City Council approved an exemption for the implementation of permit parking on Riverdale Avenue, Pape Avenue and Carlaw Avenue from the requirements of subsection 925-4B of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925, Permit Parking. Riverdale Ave, between Pape Avenue and Carlaw Avenue is presently not licensed for permit parking. Currently, parking is allowed, outside the hours of 4pm-6pm restriction, where cars are still subject to the three-hour maximum parking duration. Given that most of the residents on Riverdale Ave, between Pape Avenue and Carlaw Avenue have valid 8B permits, including this stretch of roadway would allow for more flexibility and parking availability.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate Riverdale Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Carlaw Avenue, on an area name basis, within permit parking area 8B, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
